rationale: Round 15's load-bearing change is that the ref fallback runs ONLY on a conclusive missing-ref answer: a host that never answered (spawn failure, watchdog kill, unreadable repository) must stop the read instead of licensing refs/remotes/origin/<branch>, whose commit's nomination is for different work. Neutering the guard restores the collapse review reproduced, and the boundary test that asserts origin is never even asked goes red; the prover suite, which never resolves a ref through this reader, stays green.
